messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

item: "may be only part of a complete program of treatment that also includes changes in diet or lifestyle habits"
set: ["may be only part of a complete program of treatment that also includes changes in diet or lifestyle habits", "is only part of complete treatment program", "changes in diet or lifestyle habits", "complete treatment program", "complete program of treatment for hypertension", "making lifestyle changes", "treatment may include diet", "treatment program includes diet, exercise, and weight control", "your treatment may include a special diet", "dose may need to be adjusted as diet changes", "part of this shell may appear in your stool", "hypertension treatment program", "Part of this shell", "your treatment may also include counseling or other treatments", "not a complete list of side effects", "these may be signs of a serious condition"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
